_about: American Battle Monuments Commission, Burial and Memorialization Directory (weremember.abmc.gov), read in a browser 2 October 2026 while looking for portraits of the 16 imageless war memorial records. ABMC records carry no portraits: a cemetery illustration and, for some, a scanned card. They are a source for the records' facts.

560 Garry Wingfield.note: Missing in Action: commemorated at Manila (Walls of the Missing), not buried there as the legacy page's Remains line reads.
